full_prompt_en: A square floral painting fills the entire frame with oversized blossoms and almost no empty background. Near the center, a large pale mint flower faces forward, its ribbed petals radiating around a warm yellow-orange center. To its right, a turquoise bloom spreads wide with a golden green heart. Pink, peach, lilac, violet, and apricot flowers overlap around these two anchors, some facing the viewer and others turning sideways to show curled petal edges. Thin stems and layered blue-green leaves are visible only in narrow gaps between the broad petals. The flowers are tightly cropped at all four edges, giving the impression that the arrangement continues beyond the image. Each petal is built from long, curved, ribbonlike strokes. Pale highlights run along raised folds, while darker teal, magenta, and purple marks sit in recesses, making the painted surfaces feel almost sculpted. Bright yellow stamens are carefully dotted or brushed within the centers. The light is broad and even, without a single cast shadow, but color and tonal variation give individual blooms depth. The palette moves between cool aqua and mint, warm coral and gold, and deep violet. The overall field is very busy, yet the larger central blossoms and repeated round centers establish a readable rhythm. There is no vase, table, or visible setting; the flowers alone become a tactile all-over composition. The painting feels lush and joyful, with dense, deliberate impasto-like strokes turning familiar petals into layered streams of color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形花卉绘画用放大的花朵填满整个画面，几乎没有空背景。中央附近一朵大浅薄荷色花正面对镜头，带棱线花瓣围绕暖黄橙花心放射。右侧一朵青绿花宽阔展开，有金绿色中心。粉、桃、淡紫、紫和杏色花朵围绕这两个锚点重叠，有些正面朝观众，有些侧转露出卷曲花瓣边缘。细茎和层叠蓝绿叶只在宽花瓣间狭缝可见。四边的花朵都被紧密裁掉，使排列仿佛延续到画外。每片花瓣由长而弯的丝带状笔触构造。浅高光沿凸起折面延伸，较暗的深青、洋红和紫色落在凹处，使绘画表面几乎像雕塑。花心内明黄花蕊以细点或小笔认真画出。光宽泛均匀，没有单一投影，但颜色和色调变化赋予单朵花体积。调色在冷水蓝与薄荷、暖珊瑚与金，以及深紫之间游走。整体区域非常繁忙，然而较大的中央花及重复圆花心建立可读节奏。没有花瓶、桌子或可见环境；花本身成为可触的全画面构图。绘画丰茂而喜悦，密集、有意的厚涂般笔触把熟悉花瓣化为层层颜色溪流。
style_prompt_en: Color-rich painting fills a frame with overlapping rounded forms made from long curved, ribbonlike strokes. Cool mint, aqua, turquoise, and teal interlace with coral, pink, apricot, yellow, violet, and magenta. Raised-looking highlights and darker grooves give otherwise flat color an impasto-like sculptural texture. Crop the repeated forms at the edges to create an abundant all-over field, but use a few larger central shapes and circular accents for rhythm. Broad even light keeps every layer visible; depth comes from overlap and color variation rather than hard cast shadow. The result is lush, tactile, and exuberant.
style_prompt_zh: 色彩丰厚的绘画以长而弯曲、丝带般笔触构成的重叠圆润形状填满画框。冷薄荷、水蓝、青绿与深青同珊瑚、粉、杏、黄、紫和洋红交织。凸起般高光与较暗沟槽使原本扁平的颜色有厚涂式雕塑质感。重复形状在边缘被裁掉，形成丰盛的全画面色域，少数较大中央形体和圆形重音建立节奏。宽泛均匀光让每层可见；纵深来自重叠和色彩变化，而非硬投影。效果丰茂、可触、热烈。
theme_en: A dense arrangement of oversized pastel flowers with layered ribbonlike petals
theme_zh: 大片粉彩花朵密集排列，花瓣像层叠丝带
name: Juliana Nan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
